claim_decisions.qualification: Describe format, not efficacy

claim_decisions.claim: Zen12 has 12 levels and four listening formats
claim_decisions.qualification: Formats: guided/music/white noise/nature
Only the exact observed full checkout; recheck before release

claim_decisions.claim: Zen12 equals 60 minutes of advanced meditation
claim_decisions.qualification: Explicitly label claim unsubstantiated; review did not test Zen12
EEG review heterogeneous and mixed
No product-specific reliable clinical substantiation
No unspecified medical promises
Literature on other audio does not validate product

claim_decisions.claim: Intensive meditation training can alter lab attentional blink
claim_decisions.qualification: Three-month intensive training, cannot transfer effect to Zen12
5 supportive,8 contradictory,1 mixed; method heterogeneity
Do not infer acoustics; test files unavailable

claim_decisions.claim: Classic binaural beats require separate tones at ears
claim_decisions.qualification: Not evidence about actual Zen12 file technology
Do not adopt vendor promise; operative terms inaccessible
No fixed figures, no copied countdown
Notice without presuming marketing always sent

claim_decisions.claim: Inspire3 may share purchaser name/email/product with affiliate
claim_decisions.qualification: Separate policy permission from actual transfer evidence
Named acceptance, exact earning URL and channel rights required

claim_decisions.claim: FV receives only aggregate partner reports
claim_decisions.qualification: Require contract excluding all identifiable purchaser data
Plain language near CTA; policy page alone inadequate

claim_decisions.claim: Independent source guide may discuss product
claim_decisions.qualification: No personal testimonials, unsupported effects or merchant activation

claim_decisions.claim: Attentional blink is an eyelid blink
claim_decisions.qualification: Laboratory target-report effect, not eye closure
270-ms interval began ~180 ms after target in original conditions
Spatial shift changes sparing

claim_decisions.claim: Emotion can alter blink results in studied tasks
claim_decisions.qualification: No universal fear boosts perception claim

claim_decisions.claim: A self-directed three-day format comparison proves health benefit
claim_decisions.qualification: Exercise labels unvalidated consumer preference
Requires consented, adequate comparison, exposure denominators
No invented affiliate URL or substitution
Track events and sales separately, if ever allowed
Keep existing Jetpack/Focus funnel
Only analogy about evidence and witness interpretation
